units.source_text: 对了对了，只因头绪纷繁，不觉遗漏了一个人：

en.t: Ah yes, with so many matters tangled together, one person had inadvertently been left out:

units.source_text: 伊势斋宫处，源氏公子也曾遣使送信去。

en.t: Prince Genji had also sent a messenger with a letter to the Ise Vestal Princess.

units.source_text: 六条妃子也特地遣使送来回信。

en.t: Lady Rokujo likewise made a point of sending a messenger back with a reply.
Her reply was full of lingering affection.

units.source_text: 措词之妥帖与笔致之优秀，与众不同，确有高雅的风度。

en.t: The tact of her wording and the excellence of her handwriting set it apart from all the others and showed a truly refined grace.

units.source_text: 其中有云：“足下所居之处，似非现实世间。

en.t: In it she wrote, "The place where you now dwell seems hardly to belong to the real world.

units.source_text: 我等闻此消息，几疑身在梦中。

en.t: When we heard this news, we almost wondered whether we ourselves were in a dream.

units.source_text: 思量起来，总不致长年离京远客吧。

en.t: Thinking it over, surely you will not remain for years a traveler far from the capital.

units.source_text: 但我身前世罪孽深重，再见之日，遥遥无期矣。

en.t: Yet the sins of my former lives must be heavy, and the day when I may see you again lies far beyond any promise.
